reviews.comment:
La estación está bien, pero ya no es vital por que hay estaciones en el cruce y si haces 20km más hay una YPF más moderna y con menos gente. En el cambio de mes había solamente 2 playeros atendiendo muuuuy lento y las colas eran gigantes.

(Translated by Google)
The station is okay, but it's not essential anymore because there are stations at the intersection, and if you drive 20km further there's a more modern YPF with fewer people. At the beginning of the month, there were only two attendants, serving customers very slowly, and the lines were enormous.
